title: docs(pm-dispatch): release board protocol — target:<major> as a standing release-readiness axis
body:
## Summary

Adds the **release board protocol** (`target:<major>`) to the PM dispatch skill — a standing release-readiness axis, ruled by the maintainer on 2026-08-06 after the v17 release-triage sweep.

Maintainer's original pain point (quoted verbatim, untranslated per language policy): 「我想发版本了,不可能清单上这么多问题都处理,那哪些优先,我始终没有渠道知道。」 Previous one-shot sweeps rotted because the label had no producer, no consumer, and no owner. This PR wires all three into the standing machinery:

| Piece | Where |
|---|---|
| New subsection「发版板」: binary criteria (4 blocker classes), triage-seat as the single producer, three consumers, staleness recheck cadence, release-time clear-the-board (fix / unlabel / accept-with-note) | after 发现分诊轮 |
| Batch selection: board items rank above the normal queue, below `priority:p0`; ordering not exemption | step 3 |
| Fourth bounded health metric: open release-blocker count and trend (zero = shippable) | step 9 |
| State-model table row for `target:<major>` | State model |

No moves, no rewording of existing text (+35/−1) — per the #5925-7 ruling the slimming split ships as its own pure-move PR, next in this serial chain.

## Authorization (Guardrails exception clause)

Maintainer-directed work, same session chain as #6029: the release-board mechanism was proposed by the PM and approved by the maintainer in conversation (2026-08-06, 「扫」 directive + acceptance of the six-point continuous-iteration design; PM session `session_01GcjbQLUQKysMU9uXB34iyv`). Walkthrough belongs to the maintainer; this session does not self-approve or self-queue without it.

## Verification

Docs-only (`.claude/` internal tooling, `skip-changeset` label path). Markdown structure self-checked; the board itself is already live (objectstack 43 / objectui 3 graded 2026-08-06, queries linked from #4604-adjacent reporting).
